result.description: OrionVault Aurelia is a 6TB desktop archive drive designed for quiet home-office backup, media libraries, and long-term file storage. It uses a standard USB 3.2 Gen 1 connection and a compact powered enclosure for plug-and-play use with PCs, laptops, and routers that support external storage. Optimized for steady sequential transfers and low acoustic output rather than gaming or workstation acceleration.
